qa.question: Starting at the front of the sofa, give turn-by-turn directions to the fridge.
qa.answer:
Starting at the front of the sofa, give turn-by-turn directions to the fridge.**
Two honest caveats first: I never stood at the sofa, so I have no coordinate for it (I only saw it in the south part of the big room, with the TV on the wall in front of it), and the "fridge" is only a guess — my note calls it a "tall black glossy object (possible fridge)" on the east side of the big room near the doorway. With that said, the best route I can give:

- Stand at the front of the sofa with your back to it, i.e. facing the TV wall, then turn 180° so you are facing north, back toward the doorway end of the room.
- Walk north roughly 1.5–2 m across the light-grey tile until you are near my anchor "big_room_doorway_inside" (2.72, 2.47), recognisable by the dark pedestal table right above/beside you and the corridor doorway to the north.
- Turn right, to face east, and go about 0.3–0.5 m. The tall black glossy object should be right there against the east side by the doorway.

Note this is nearly the opposite direction from the confirmed kitchen fittings (range and counter), which are in the *south-east* corner at about y < 1.0.

qa.answer:
How many rooms did you visit? Name them.**
My trajectory was corridor_start → big_room → kitchen → corridor_start, so I physically stood in three named places, but they are really only two separate spaces: the corridor, and the big tiled room whose south-east corner is the kitchen. My fourth map entry, "kitchen_area," was logged early from the corridor and I now believe it is a duplicate sighting of the same tiled room/kitchen, not a fourth place.

Southeast. In practice: walk east down the corridor, then turn south through the mid-corridor doorway into the big room and continue to its far south-east corner.
